records.title: Energy comparisons
records.summary: Keep the cutoff and numerical settings consistent when comparing energies. Check convergence for the property you need.
conditions: Use the same functional and compatible PAW datasets for the comparison.
limitations: A successful run or a stored cutoff is not a convergence study.

records.title: Magnetic seeds
records.summary: Initial moments affect symmetry and the state reached. Compare plausible seeds and inspect the final site moments; zero total moment can be valid AFM.
conditions: Compare accepted runs with the same cell, method and numerical settings.
Keep moments in uploaded site order.
limitations: The lowest energy among tested seeds is not proof of the global ground state.
PAW-sphere moments do not equal the full-cell moment.

records.title: DFT+U
records.summary: This runner uses Dudarev U-J. Ask for the element, orbital, U, J and source. Preserve the required on-site charge information for downstream spectra.
conditions: Keep U and J fixed when ranking total energies.
Charge reuse needs LMAXMIX=4 for d shells or 6 for f shells.
limitations: Composition alone does not determine U or J.
A saved example value is not a recommendation for another material.

records.title: SOC coordinates
records.summary: SOC needs vasp_ncl. Specify vector moments in the SAXIS spinor basis and preserve the lattice frame.
conditions: Review symmetry and the moment direction relative to the lattice.
limitations: SOC workflow success does not establish convergence of small anisotropy energies.

records.title: Hybrid bands
records.summary: Use a regular weighted mesh with a zero-weight band path and solve self-consistently. Do not use ICHARG=11 for hybrid bands.
conditions: This runner requires VASP 6 with LFOCKACE support.
Check convergence of the zero-weight path states separately.
limitations: Total-energy convergence alone does not prove path-state convergence.
The bundled examples are not band-gap benchmarks.

sources.title: VASP: Band-structure calculation using hybrid functionals

records.title: PBE spectra
records.summary: PBE bands and DOS reuse a converged SCF CHGCAR in this runner. Keep the structure, site order and method consistent.
conditions: Obtain the charge density on a mesh covering the Brillouin zone before ICHARG=11.
limitations: Fixed-charge spectra are not the hybrid workflow.
DFT+U also needs sufficient LMAXMIX in the upstream calculation.

records.title: Occupations
records.summary: Choose occupations for the electronic state. Positive ISMEAR can give unphysical occupations in insulators.
conditions: Tetrahedron integration needs an appropriate Gamma-centered mesh.
limitations: A line path does not replace a Brillouin-zone integration mesh.

records.title: Vacuum and surfaces
records.summary: For slabs and molecules, review vacuum, cell constraints and any dipole correction before running.
conditions: Confirm the intended geometry; a long cell is only a hint of vacuum.
limitations: Charged slabs require a separate electrostatic treatment.
These notes do not provide converged surface or defect formation energies.

records.title: Si workflow
records.summary: Silicon passed relaxation, SCF, bands and DOS with the same PBE method and checked structure handoffs.
conditions: Two-atom Si cell; nonmagnetic PBE; no SOC or U.
limitations: This is a functional example, not a material-accuracy or convergence benchmark.
The coarse validation mesh is a starting example, not a converged setting.

evidence.description: Published acceptance and preserved output hashes

records.title: Fe magnetism
records.summary: The collinear Fe SCF run converged and retained finite local moments.
conditions: Two Fe sites, initial moments +3 and +3 muB; PBE without SOC or U.
limitations: This is a functional example, not a material-accuracy or convergence benchmark.
This run alone does not select the magnetic ground state.

evidence.description: Published acceptance and preserved output hashes

records.title: Fe with SOC
records.summary: The Fe SOC run converged with a nondefault SAXIS and checked vector moments.
conditions: Two Fe sites; PBE with SOC; no U.
SAXIS is parallel to [1,1,1]; input vectors use that spinor basis.
limitations: This is a functional example, not a material-accuracy or convergence benchmark.
The result is not a magnetic-anisotropy benchmark.

evidence.description: Published acceptance and preserved output hashes

records.title: NiO with U
records.summary: The collinear NiO SCF run passed with opposite Ni seeds and explicit Dudarev U and J.
conditions: Four-site NiO cell; PBE; Ni d-shell U=5 eV, J=0 eV; no SOC.
Ni seeds are +2 and -2 muB; O seeds are zero.
limitations: This is a functional example, not a material-accuracy or convergence benchmark.
U=5 eV is the validation choice, not an inferred material default.

evidence.description: Published acceptance and preserved output hashes

records.title: Si HSE06 bands
records.summary: Silicon HSE06 bands passed the parser and independent spectrum checks on VASP 6.2.1.
conditions: Nonmagnetic Si, no SOC or U; a weighted mesh and zero-weight path are solved together.
limitations: This is a functional example, not a material-accuracy or convergence benchmark.
Path-state and k-mesh convergence still need checking for a scientific band gap.

records.title: NiO HSE06, U and SOC
records.summary: The combined HSE06, Dudarev U and SOC SCF probe passed with checked method tags.
conditions: Four-site NiO cell; Ni d-shell U=5 eV, J=0 eV; opposite Ni vector seeds.
Default SAXIS; VASP 6.2.1.
limitations: This is a functional example, not a material-accuracy or convergence benchmark.
This checks method propagation; it does not justify combining hybrid exchange and U for a new material.

evidence.description: Published acceptance and preserved output hashes

records.title: Electronic step limit
records.summary: The NELM=1 Si control failed electronic convergence. A reviewed increase to 120 converged with all other inputs unchanged.
conditions: Current VASP output confirms electronic nonconvergence with a finite NELM; missing output or unknown solver errors are outside this repair.
Extra steps are a bounded trial; a repeated or oscillating SCF failure needs separate diagnosis.
limitations: A proposal still needs review; this record does not authorize submission or a wider repair.
Verified on one PBE Si control; extra steps do not resolve every SCF failure.

evidence.description: Original failure, reviewed change and accepted repair

records.title: Ionic step limit
records.summary: The displaced Si control stopped after one ionic step above its force target. A reviewed increase to NSW=100 reached the unchanged target.
conditions: Electronic iterations are usable but the force target is not reached.
Keep the method, force threshold and initial structure unchanged for this repair.
limitations: A proposal still needs review; this record does not authorize submission or a wider repair.
Verified on one displaced PBE Si control; this does not prove a stable structure or recover every failed relaxation.

evidence.description: Original failure, reviewed change and accepted repair

records.title: Time limit
records.summary: A delayed Si job timed out after one minute. A reviewed two-minute limit completed the same calculation.
conditions: The scheduler confirms TIMEOUT and the original calculation inputs are intact.
Check the existing job identity and status before proposing another run.
limitations: A proposal still needs review; this record does not authorize submission or a wider repair.
This control injected a 75-second startup delay; two minutes is not a production runtime estimate.

evidence.description: Original failure, reviewed change and accepted repair

records.title: VASP 5 hybrid bands
records.summary: A Si PBE0+SOC band run was rejected because this recipe requires VASP 6 with LFOCKACE. The following DOS stage was not submitted.
conditions: VASP 5.4.4; this runner uses the VASP 6 hybrid-band recipe.
limitations: A completed scheduler job is not an accepted scientific result.
This does not mean all hybrid calculations require VASP 6.

evidence.description: Published compatibility refusal and output hashes
